verdict_reason: The R1 discovery-preview packet and its exact allowlist are coherent and implementable for the authorized preview slice. The historical W1 contract is explicitly preserved, current-baseline adaptations are bounded, and the six freeze conditions below are sufficient to prevent contract drift during implementation.

freeze_conditions.requirement: The checked-in CAP excerpt fixture must be the exact 5804-byte copy with SHA-256 68518fe631e9e7163d97d8a2c5ed7326e8eec620148a665be42857b517db395a; incomplete excerpts remain negative metadata-completeness cases and cannot be promoted to positives.
The existing CLI may receive only one preview import and one register_preview_commands call; preview commands must serialize through the shared CLI and retain the SOURCE-CAPTURE command behavior.
Preview request, parser and storage boundaries must enforce the historical W1 one MiB limits even where existing repository contracts use larger limits.
DECISION_CONFLICT and staged reference or lineage conflicts must produce the frozen stable refusal and exit status 75, including the relevant failure paths.
The built wheel must expose all seven new schemas and the preview prompt, while the existing preview-common.v1.schema.json resource bytes remain unchanged.

The preview Skill and manifest must stay concise and automatic for inspect, revisit, request/cache, one official generated-URL open when needed, truthful observation, model preview, render and explicit selection; no unnecessary UI or unrelated files may be added.
